audit.whatIsWrong: Both level-chart layers read Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Irelia/Skill/Irelia, contradicting the packet chart AND the whys prose sitting right next to them (whys[0] and whys[1] describe Vayne winning, whys[6] describes her out-scaling).
audit.why: Vayne's Tumble (Q, 6/5/4/3/2s) auto outranges point-blank Bladesurge and Condemn (20/18/16/14/12s) punishes a stunless dash, so she owns levels 1-2; Irelia owns 4-5, 6 and first item; Silver Bolts percent-max-HP true damage takes it back at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Vayne — proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Vayne levels 1-2 and 2+ items, Irelia level 3 E, level 6 Vanguard's Edge, first item. Phase whys were rewritten to name the real spike causes instead of generic filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble is an auto-attack reset and nothing said so — the player is told to watch the cast when the attack wind-up is the actual tell. Condemn's real cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.' — autoReset flag confirmed. Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s; Tumble drops to 2s at rank 5 and lower again under Final Hour.
audit.corrected: Don'ts now names the reset wind-up as the cue; Do's now gives Condemn's 12s max-rank cooldown as the bait window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text refers to Vayne as 'his answer'.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun and vague — naming Condemn is both correct and more concrete.

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Her Tumble auto outranges Bladesurge and Condemn slams you into the wall — last-hit at range while you have no stun.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: Still no stun, so she keeps spacing with Tumble autos — farm the wave and wait for E instead of dashing in blind.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vayne must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: E is online, but she can Tumble out of the blade convergence on a 4s cooldown — bait that Q, then stun and Bladesurge.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: tighter cooldowns and Ionian Fervor stacks chain E-stun into Q-resets faster than she can kite. Force it here.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King plus W soak beats her pre-crit build — force fights on Condemn's 12s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores your armour and Final Hour invis-Tumbles break the reset chain — close the game before this.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Stun her so she can’t kite. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is down 12s at max rank — bait it, then stun before she can space out.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Tumble is a 2-4s auto-attack reset; the wind-up is the tell — step back, don't follow.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Vayne when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Vayne when Condemn is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.

notes: Level chart contradicted both the packet and its own whys text in six of seven rows; fixed as matched pairs. Vayne is referred to as 'his/he' in several inherited strings (breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, enemyWin) — flagged, not all rewritten, to stay inside the length band and edit budget.
